title: Same towel, smaller doorway
hook: Same water and model flux: which towel layout dries sooner?

knows: Everyday objects have sizes, positions and amounts
doesNotKnow: Spreading the towel exposes both large faces. This constant-rate model divides water mass by exposed area and assumed flux; a smaller evaporation doorway gives a longer model time.

misconception: The two pictured methods are interchangeable without checking their mechanism or constraints.
